target.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Zalouser maintained a private copy of offset-aware text range splitting even though outbound text and Markdown chunking belong to the shared `plugin-sdk/text-chunking` surface. That duplicated paragraph/newline/whitespace policy and made native Zalo style offsets harder to keep aligned with shared chunking behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `chunkTextRanges` to markdown-core, exports it through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking`, and migrates Zalouser while keeping only its native style slicing locally. The helper preserves every input code unit and separator, prefers paragraph/newline/whitespace boundaries when requested, and keeps surrogate pairs intact. Matrix HTML rendering and QQBot's stateful table/fence repair are intentionally unchanged because they remain channel-specific.

## User Impact

No intended change to Zalouser's rendered long-text, table, fenced-code, whitespace, or native-style output. Supplementary Unicode characters can no longer be split into invalid standalone chunks at an exact hard boundary.

## Evidence

- Before implementation: `pnpm test extensions/zalouser/src/send.test.ts` passed 17/17 tests with exact fence, table, whitespace, long-text, and style fixtures on Testbox `tbx_01kxcgntcfv6w0w9p5gd7pcxmw`.
- Exact rebased head: focused SDK + Zalouser tests passed 52/52 assertions on Testbox `tbx_01kxcjt5t2pyqre1cf6wn06vxm`, Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29218309014.
- `pnpm check:changed`, `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check`, `pnpm check:docs`, and `pnpm build` passed on the patch; the conflict-free rebase was followed by exact-head SDK surface/API-baseline checks.
- Source-blind built-API behavior contract passed hard, preferred, table, fence, repeated-whitespace, empty, fallback, and surrogate-boundary probes.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` completed clean after the accepted Unicode-boundary finding was fixed and retested.

AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this maintainer-requested cleanup.

target.title: fix(config): propagate provider-level contextTokens default to models (#105821)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`models.providers.*.contextTokens` is documented as a provider-level default effective runtime context cap for models under that provider. However, `applyModelDefaults` in `src/config/defaults.ts` only considered per-model `contextTokens`, so models that omitted the field did not inherit the provider default.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime already falls back to provider-level `contextTokens` in `applyConfiguredContextWindows`, but config consumers that read the materialized model entries—such as `openclaw models list` and config snapshots—saw `undefined` and omitted the effective cap. This brings `applyModelDefaults` in line with the documented contract and with the existing provider-level `api` default propagation.

## User Impact

Users who set `contextTokens` on a provider will now see the inherited cap reflected for every model under that provider in `openclaw models list` and other config-aware surfaces, unless a model explicitly overrides it.

## Evidence

### Unit tests
Added regression tests in `src/config/model-alias-defaults.test.ts`:

- `propagates provider-level contextTokens default to models` fails before the fix (`contextTokens` is `undefined`) and passes after (`120000`).
- `lets per-model contextTokens override provider-level default` confirms explicit model values still win.

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/model-alias-defaults.test.ts --run
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  20 passed (20)
```

### Real CLI output
Config (`~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`, redacted):

```json
{
  "models": {
    "providers": {
      "demo-provider": {
        "baseUrl": "https://demo-provider.example.test/v1",
        "apiKey": "sk-demo-redacted",
        "api": "openai-completions",
        "contextTokens": 120000,
        "models": [
          { "id": "inherited-cap", "name": "Inherited cap model", "contextWindow": 200000, "maxTokens": 8192 },
          { "id": "overridden-cap", "name": "Overridden cap model", "contextWindow": 200000, "maxTokens": 8192, "contextTokens": 96000 }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

After the fix, `openclaw models list --json --no-color` shows the inherited cap on the first model and the explicit override on the second:

```json
{
  "count": 2,
  "models": [
    {
      "key": "demo-provider/inherited-cap",
      "name": "Inherited cap model",
      "input": "text",
      "contextWindow": 200000,
      "contextTokens": 120000,
      "local": false,
      "available": true,
      "tags": ["default"],
      "missing": false
    },
    {
      "key": "demo-provider/overridden-cap",
      "name": "Overridden cap model",
      "input": "text",
      "contextWindow": 200000,
      "contextTokens": 96000,
      "local": false,
      "available": true,
      "tags": [],
      "missing": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Before the fix, the first row omitted `contextTokens` entirely.

Fixes #105821
